candidates.notes: All kanji and kana correct; furigana ごらく given inline as 娯楽(ごらく). Omits the margin line number 25. Drops the full-width indent at the start of the second paragraph (つまり…).

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Text fully correct; furigana given inline in parentheses. Keeps the paragraph indent before つまり. Only omission is the margin line number 25.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Identical to B: text correct, indent preserved, furigana inline. Margin line number 25 omitted.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Text correct; furigana inline. Uses em dashes for the closing dash, which is acceptable. Drops the indent on the second paragraph and omits line number 25.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Identical to B and C: accurate text, indent preserved, furigana inline. Line number 25 omitted.

rationale: All five candidates transcribe the passage with no character errors, all render the furigana as 娯楽(ごらく), and all omit the margin line number 25. The only real difference is that B, C and E keep the full-width indent before つまり, while A and D drop it, so B, C and E rank higher. B, C and E are identical, as are A and D apart from an equivalent dash style, so the order within each group is arbitrary.
